name: 04-16-message-jump-blank-page
title: Fix message list jump and blank page issues in long conversations
description: Investigate virtualization blank page after session switch and broken jump-list navigation after switching away and back in long session timelines.
creator: claude-agent
notes: PRD captures two linked regressions: blank page after long-session switch, and jump popover items becoming non-functional after switching away and back. Current logs show jump failures happen when target nodes are outside the active virtualized window and seek() exhausts retries.
